title: Generalizable dose denoising using diffusion transformer framework for pencil beam scanning proton therapy
abstract: arXiv:2506.04467v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Background and purpose: Intensity-modulated proton therapy (IMPT) enables conformal dose delivery for head and neck (H&N) cancers. However, its sensitivity to inter-fractional anatomical changes motivates online adaptations, where rapid and accurate Monte Carlo (MC) dose calculation remains a major bottleneck. Low-statistics MC simulations reduce computation time but introduce noise. This study aimed to develop a diffusion-transformer framework to recover high-statistics dose distributions from noisy MC simulations. Materials and methods: A diffusion-transformer-based dose denoising framework was developed. Eighty H&N patients were used for training and additional 10 H&N patients and 30 patients with lung, breast, and prostate cancers (10 per site) were used for evaluation. translated_title: 基于扩散Transformer框架的笔形束扫描质子治疗泛化性剂量去噪方法
translated_abstract: 背景与目的：调强质子治疗（IMPT）能够为头颈部（H&N）癌症实现适形剂量照射。然而，其对分次间解剖变化的敏感性促使了在线自适应治疗的需求，而快速且准确的蒙特卡洛（MC）剂量计算仍是主要瓶颈。低统计量的MC模拟可以减少计算时间，但会引入噪声。本研究旨在开发一种扩散-Transformer框架，从含噪的MC模拟中恢复高统计量的剂量分布。材料与方法：研究开发了一种基于扩散-Transformer的剂量去噪框架。80例头颈部患者用于训练，另外10例头颈部患者以及30例肺癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌患者（每个部位10例）用于评估。含噪和高统计量的剂量图使用MCsquare生成。模型以含噪剂量图和CT图像作为输入进行训练，输出为高统计量剂……（原文摘要截断）
tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于扩散Transformer的剂量去噪框架，可从低统计量蒙特卡洛模拟中快速恢复高统计量的质子剂量分布，并在头颈、肺、乳腺和前列腺等多种癌症患者中展现出良好的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This study develops a diffusion-transformer-based dose denoising framework that recovers high-statistics dose distributions from noisy low-statistics Monte Carlo simulations for pencil beam scanning proton therapy, demonstrating strong generalizability across head-and-neck, lung, breast, and prostate cancer patients.
